name: projectportfolio
description: ProjectPortfolio: a mobile-first, real-time collaborative work-breakdown whiteboard (React + Firebase)

scripts.test: for t in test/formula test/merge canvas-kit/test/rollup; do esbuild $t.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=node_modules/.cache/$(basename $t).test.mjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/$(basename $t).test.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@13 emulators:exec --only firestore,database --project demo-projectportfolio "node test/rules.test.mjs"
